name: כָּל־חֹזֶה
gloss: every seer; or he sees all
summary: The father of Shallun, ruler of the district of Mizpah, who repaired the fountain gate (Neh 3:15), and a man of Judah in the line of Maaseiah, son of Hazaiah (Neh 11:5); possibly one man. The name is כֹּל “all, every” with חֹזֶה “seer” or “one who sees”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Shallun son of כָּל־חֹזֶה, ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the fountain gate.”
“Maaseiah son of Baruch, son of כָּל־חֹזֶה, son of Hazaiah.”
“By every prophet and every seer (כָל־חֹזֶה)”: the same two words as a phrase.

note: Takes k.bm.ad (BDB files it under כלח); its two tokens are also counted under h.bp.ac by spelling. TIPNR keeps two records; they may be one man.
